_read_me: Every link and Flodesk slot for /roadmap and /roadmap-tool lives here. Fill a slot, then run: python3 scripts/make_roadmap.py

launch-planner.name: Digital Product Launch Planner
launch-planner.summary: A 6 week launch planner for bloggers, coaches and course creators launching a product to their email list. Enter your launch date and it fills in the due dates, email schedule and sales math. Ready-made tasks, hooks and email slots, plus a full example launch. It doesn't write your emails. Google Sheets, with an XLSX version included.
details: Start page: date entry, color key, five launch rules
Setup: price, cart length (3, 5 or 7 days), list size, sales goal, revenue at 1%, 2% and 3% conversion
Map of 7 launch emails to cart days, with each email's job
6 week timeline of 51 tasks with auto due dates and progress
Content calendar with 20 launch posts (hook, call to action, link)
Promo tracker per cart day and a numbers review sheet
Worked example (a $27 meal plan launch) plus a printable PDF
launch-planner.feel: You can feel there's an offer in you. You just don't know where to start, and every blank page makes you second guess the whole idea.

starter-kit.name: The Blog to Paid Starter Kit
starter-kit.summary: 22 templates, swipe files, workbooks and planners for selling your own product from your blog, in the order you use them. Worth $460 bought piece by piece. Tools only, not coaching.
details: Offer: one-sentence offer worksheet, validation scorecard, pricing calculator, pricing confidence scripts, offer-first business plan
Words: blog post outline, testimonial collection kit, sales page copy template
List and emails: lead magnet workbook, freebie planner and opt-in copy, quiz funnel kit, welcome sequence, 7-email launch sequence, Flodesk newsletter graphics
Content: 90-day long-form content plan, 20 Pinterest pin templates, Notion blog business dashboard
Products and launch: ebook Canva template, coaching workbook bundle, mini-course kit, client welcome packet, digital product launch planner
Start Here PDF with every link, in order
starter-kit.feel: You know who you help. Now you want words and a look that make her feel like you built this just for her, instead of rewriting your homepage for the fifth time.

welcome-sequence.name: Welcome Sequence Swipe File
welcome-sequence.summary: Five welcome emails for someone who just got your freebie, over 7 days: deliver the freebie, build trust, teach one idea, make a plain offer, final nudge. Google Doc.
details: 5 full emails (Day 0 to Day 7): subject, preview text, body, button text, P.S.
3 alternate subject lines per email
3 swap-in offer emails: low-priced template, higher-priced course or kit, free call
Fill-in sheet with 11 placeholders and sample answers
6 step Flodesk setup guide and 5 deliverability tips
Worked example and a pre-publish checklist
welcome-sequence.feel: You want every new subscriber to feel welcomed instead of forgotten, and to know exactly what to buy from you when she's ready.

content-plan.name: 90-Day Long-Form Content Plan
content-plan.bonus: 20 Pinterest Pin Templates for Offer-Led Blog Posts
content-plan.summary: 13 weeks of blog posts, podcast episodes or videos where every piece points to something you sell. Google Sheets.
details: Start Here and Setup: platform, 1 or 2 pieces a week, 3 offers with their call to action words, 3 content pillars
90 day plan: 13 weeks of dated rows, rotations, title prompts, status, offer counters
Repurpose tracker: 3 pins, 1 email, an optional short clip per piece
Idea bank of 60 offer-led title prompts
Monthly review and a filled-in example plus printable PDF
content-plan.feel: You're tired of staring at a blank post wondering what to write this week. You want every post to have a job, and to know it's walking her toward your offer.

pin-templates.name: 20 Pinterest Pin Templates for Offer-Led Blog Posts
pin-templates.summary: 20 editable pins (1000 x 1500) in free Canva for posts that lead to a freebie or product.
details: 4 how-to, 4 list and mistakes, 4 freebie, 4 product, 4 story and quote pins
Varied layouts with labeled photo spots
Pin Playbook (2 page PDF) and Start Here guide with Brand Kit steps
License: your own blog and business, not client work
pin-templates.feel: You want the right women finding your posts and landing on your freebie, without designing every pin from scratch on a week you barely have time to breathe.

launch-kit.name: The Launch Kit
launch-kit.summary: The page, the proof, the emails and the plan for launching a digital product, course or coaching offer. 4 products for one price.
details: Digital Product Launch Planner
Sales Page Copy Template (11 sections, 2 finished examples)
Testimonial and Proof Kit (request emails, form, 12 Canva graphics, case study template)
7-Email Launch Sequence Swipe File
Start Here PDF
launch-kit.feel: You have something real to sell. This time you want to launch it like you mean it, with a plan, instead of posting once and hoping somebody notices.

dashboard.name: Blog Business Dashboard (Notion)
dashboard.summary: One Notion page for your offers, content, emails, launches and money, each linked back to an offer so you can see what's making money. Pre-filled with an example. Free Notion plan. You log payments and email stats by hand in a 20 minute weekly review. It doesn't connect to Stripe, Etsy or email tools.
details: Home: this week's tasks, order of work, Friday review checklist, monthly money check
Offers, Content, Emails, Launches, Money, Tasks and Ideas databases
Start Here PDF
dashboard.feel: Your business is working, and right now it lives in your head and too many open tabs. You want one calm place to run it, so you can finally breathe.
